contract: Pure Conway Life in Bend 2.0.29. Public operations: step(width: U32, height: U32, cells: List<&2,U32>) -> List<&2,U32>; evolve(turns: Nat, width: U32, height: U32, cells: List<&2,U32>) -> List<&2,U32>. Reusable parameter annotations may vary as required by the checker. Valid dimensions are 0..32 inclusive; cells contains exactly width*height binary values in row-major order. The exterior is permanently dead, with no wrapping. Each synchronous step counts the eight OLD-board neighbors excluding the center: birth at three, survival at two or three, otherwise death. Return the complete ordered board, preserving binary range, exact shape and reusable input. evolve(0,w,h,c)=c; evolve performs exactly turns steps; evolving a then b agrees with a+b; empty boards remain empty. Finite behavioral gates exercise turns 0..8 but are not a universal proof. Invalid shapes, nonbinary inputs and dimensions outside the domain are unspecified. Only Base is imported; no foreign code, IO, holes, unsafe annotations, new axioms or fixture-specific behavior. No speed, GPU or universal correctness claim is established by this style review.

import Base

# Height is the fuel; valid boards make every slice exactly width.
def Life.rows(
  height: Nat, +width: Nat, +cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, List<&2, U32>>:
  match height:
    case 0n:
      Nil{}
    case 1n+more:
      List.take(&2, U32, cells, width) <>
        Life.rows(more, width, List.drop(&2, U32, cells, width))

# The cursor carries nw/w/sw; n/cell/s become the next west column.
def Life.stencil(
  +here: List<&2, U32>,
  +north: List<&2, U32>,
  +south: List<&2, U32>,
  nw: U32,
  w: U32,
  sw: U32
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match here:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case cell <> eastward:
      +n = Maybe.default(&2, U32, List.head(&2, U32, north), 0)
      ne = Maybe.default(
        &2, U32, List.head(&2, U32, List.tail(&2, U32, north)), 0)
      e = Maybe.default(&2, U32, List.head(&2, U32, eastward), 0)
      +s = Maybe.default(&2, U32, List.head(&2, U32, south), 0)
      se = Maybe.default(
        &2, U32, List.head(&2, U32, List.tail(&2, U32, south)), 0)
      +neighbors = (nw + n + ne + w + e + sw + s + se : U32)
      Bool.to_u32(Bool.or(
        U32.is_eq(neighbors, 3),
        Bool.and(U32.is_eq(cell, 1), U32.is_eq(neighbors, 2)))) <>
        Life.stencil(
          eastward,
          List.tail(&2, U32, north),
          List.tail(&2, U32, south),
          n,
          cell,
          s)

# One dead row closes both ends of the vertical sweep.
def Life.sweep(
  +rows: List<&2, List<&2, U32>>,
  +dead: List<&2, U32>,
  north: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, List<&2, U32>>:
  match rows:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case here <> rest:
      south = Maybe.default(
        &2,
        List<&2, U32>,
        List.head(&2, List<&2, U32>, rest),
        dead)
      Life.stencil(here, north, south, 0, 0, 0) <>
        Life.sweep(rest, dead, here)

def step(
  width: U32, height: U32, cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  +columns = U32.to_nat(width)
  +dead = List.replicate(U32, columns, 0)
  List.concat(
    &2,
    U32,
    Life.sweep(
      Life.rows(U32.to_nat(height), columns, cells),
      dead,
      dead))

def evolve(
  turns: Nat, +width: U32, +height: U32, cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match turns:
    case 0n:
      cells
    case 1n+more:
      evolve(more, width, height, step(width, height, cells))
